inputs.name: action_principles
examples: 现代实战拳法、肘击、膝撞、低位踢击、近身控制、擒拿拆解和短距离摔法

descriptions.en: Technique vocabulary (strikes, clinch, takedowns, etc.)
descriptions.zh-CN: 动作组成与技术库（拳肘膝踢、擒拿、摔法等）

descriptions.en: Antagonist face, age, hair, build, wardrobe, and temperament
descriptions.zh-CN: 敌人的面部、年龄、发型、体型、服装、气质描述

descriptions.en: Antagonist reference image @-ref; must differ from the protagonist ref
descriptions.zh-CN: 敌人参考图资产的 @ 引用，不得与主角引用相同

descriptions.en: Output aspect ratio
descriptions.zh-CN: 输出视频画幅

descriptions.en: Picture-synced location sound list; no dialogue and only restrained low-frequency music by default
descriptions.zh-CN: 严格同步画面的现场声清单；默认无对白、音乐仅极克制低频脉冲

inputs.name: camera_follow_spec
examples: 肩后、腰后、侧后第三人称跟随；关键格挡和重击短暂切入侧面中景或近景

descriptions.en: Protagonist-centered camera set and key-hit shot-size rules
descriptions.zh-CN: 主角中心机位集合与关键命中景别规则

descriptions.en: Camera weight, impact shake, and key-moment clarity rules
descriptions.zh-CN: 摄影机重量感、撞击震动与关键清晰度规则

inputs.name: character_dynamics
examples: 主角冷静精准动作幅度小、格挡后即反击；敌人力量更大、连续压迫与贴身撞击

descriptions.en: Fighting-style and temperament contrast between the two
descriptions.zh-CN: 双方的格斗风格与性格差异

descriptions.en: Invisible-cut whitelist and state that must survive each cut
descriptions.zh-CN: 切镜手段白名单与切镜后必须延续的状态

inputs.name: dual_consistency_lock
examples: 严格继承参考图两人的面部、体型、服装与气质，全程不得交换身份

descriptions.en: No identity swap / face drift / wardrobe-body change / third combatant lock
descriptions.zh-CN: 不交换身份/不变脸/不改服装体型/无第三者的锁定声明

descriptions.en: Total duration; the fight timeline must cover it continuously
descriptions.zh-CN: 视频总时长，格斗时间线必须连续覆盖

inputs.name: ending_directive
examples: 最后一帧保持双方继续互相锁定的危险状态，为下一段战斗留下衔接

descriptions.en: How the video ends
descriptions.zh-CN: 结尾执行方式

inputs.name: environment_interaction
examples: 立柱、闸机、玻璃护栏、积水参与战斗；闸机挡板可撞开弯曲但不脱离，玻璃震颤不碎，立柱不碎裂

descriptions.en: How environment objects join the fight and their damage limits
descriptions.zh-CN: 环境物件参与战斗的方式与损毁边界

inputs.name: fight_arc
examples: 敌人抢攻→主角反击→绕柱追击→主角失势→危险拆解→夺回主动→环境摔投→最终反制；主角必须经历一次明显失势和一次危险化解

descriptions.en: Phase arc of the fight and offense/defense balance
descriptions.zh-CN: 整场格斗的阶段弧线与双方攻守平衡要求

descriptions.en: Per-beat choreography: time range, camera, origin/path/contact/result, invisible cut, momentum handoff
descriptions.zh-CN: 逐拍攻防编排：时间区间、机位、起点/路径/接触点/结果、隐形切点、惯性延续

inputs.name: final_feel
examples: 刺激而不混乱，凶狠但遵守人体力学，摄影机始终以主角为核心

descriptions.en: Overall feel declaration of the final footage
descriptions.zh-CN: 成片整体气质声明

descriptions.en: Overall footage style declaration
descriptions.zh-CN: 整体影像气质声明

descriptions.en: Output frame rate
descriptions.zh-CN: 输出视频帧率

inputs.name: lighting_palette
examples: 冷白顶灯主光（两盏偶尔闪烁），红色警示灯局部轮廓光，冷蓝灰主色

descriptions.en: Key light, rim light, palette, and material requirements
descriptions.zh-CN: 主光、轮廓光、主色调与材质要求

descriptions.en: Negative constraint list; template defaults are merged
descriptions.zh-CN: 负面约束清单；模板内置默认负面项会并入

descriptions.en: Protagonist face, age, hair, build, wardrobe, and temperament
descriptions.zh-CN: 主角的面部、年龄、发型、体型、服装、气质描述

descriptions.en: Protagonist reference image @-ref; must differ from the antagonist ref
descriptions.zh-CN: 主角参考图资产的 @ 引用，不得与敌人引用相同

descriptions.en: Optional delivery-platform banner line rendered at the top; omitted when empty
descriptions.zh-CN: 可选的投递平台标识行，渲染在 Prompt 顶部；留空则省略

descriptions.en: Skin, muscle, fabric, material, and lighting realism requirements
descriptions.zh-CN: 皮肤、肌肉、衣料、材质、光影等写实要求

descriptions.en: Output video resolution
descriptions.zh-CN: 输出视频分辨率

descriptions.en: One-line summary of who fights whom and where
descriptions.zh-CN: 一句话说明谁与谁在何处对战

descriptions.en: Fight scene environment, materials, and atmosphere
descriptions.zh-CN: 格斗场景的环境、材质与氛围细节

descriptions.en: Opening positions, movement path, landmark placement, and axis rules
descriptions.zh-CN: 开场站位、战斗移动路径、关键地物位置与行动轴线规则

inputs.name: style_reference
examples: 现代硬派武术电影气质 + ACT 动作游戏第三人称战斗镜头

descriptions.en: Temperament/lens-language reference; never copies characters, locations, or shots
descriptions.zh-CN: 只继承气质与镜头语言的参照描述，不得照搬人物/场景/镜头
